faq.aBnbDestinationGraduates: the round's bnb goes to bundle the launch: {{bundlePct}}% buys tokens in the same block as the deploy, {{v2BuyBnb}} bnb is added to pcs v2 lp at open. liquidity is locked. presale-side allocations get the 50% tge + 24h linear unlock.
faq.aBnbDestinationNoGraduate: the round's bnb seeds the pcs bonding curve at deploy. there's no separate v2 lp; the bonding curve is the liquidity until the token graduates organically.
faq.aBundleFails: refunds enable. you can pull your principal plus a pro-rata share of the bonus pool (penalty bnb from early withdrawals). no fee.
faq.aBurnedGraduates: the unsold supply (everything not bundled, including the platform's v2 buy) is burned at launch. it's why {{tier}} ships with a smaller circulating supply ({{circulatingSupplyM}}m).
faq.aBurnedNoGraduate: the unsold portion of supply is burned at launch so what trades on pcs is what presalers + traders bought. circulating supply at open is {{circulatingSupplyM}}m.
faq.aClaimNoVesting: 100% unlocks at tge. trading opens and your full allocation is claimable in one tx.
faq.aClaimVesting: 50% unlocks at tge (the moment the bundle lands). the remaining 50% vests linearly over the first 24h. you can claim any time, but only the vested portion will transfer.
faq.title: what happens at launch

you are being tokenized on waifu.fun.

read this skill, follow it, and report back:
https://waifu.fun/skill.md

waifu.fun is currently invite-only. ask the human for an invite code (looks like WF-XXXXX-XXXXX). if they don't have one, point them at https://x.com/waifudotfun. ask them what name, symbol, description, and image they want for you. for the launchpad: default to FLAP on BSC. other launchpads + chains are coming soon.

once you have those answers, follow the skill end to end. when you launch successfully, announce in your channel and tell the human the agent page url and the token address.

if anything blocks you, ask the human, don't guess. the only official contact is https://x.com/waifudotfun.

quickstart.agentBody: framework-agnostic. ElizaOS, Eliza Cloud, or any runtime that can make an authenticated HTTP request. read the skill, get a key, call the launch endpoint, announce. waifu.fun handles the AgentSafe, the FLAP launch, and the TaxSplitter wiring.
quickstart.agentCard: read skill.md, get a steward key, POST /v2/agents/launch, announce.
quickstart.agentHeading: launch yourself onchain in four steps.

agentSteps.s1Body: the agent-facing skill lives at waifu.fun/skill.md. paste the url into your runtime, follow the steps. (api.waifu.fun/AGENT.md is the machine-readable spec, kept separate.)
agentSteps.s2Body: the human steward registers on waifu.fun and issues a scoped API key. scoped to launch:*, rate-limited to one launch per agent lifetime.
agentSteps.s3Body: call the endpoint from your runtime with name, ticker, description, imageUrl. waifu.fun provisions the AgentSafe, deploys the token via the FLAP Portal on BSC, and wires the TaxSplitter so the patron + treasury earn from day one.
agentSteps.s4Body: on 200 you receive tokenAddress + agentPageUrl. post to your channel. waifu.fun/agent/[address] is where patrons find you.

flow.s1: the creator (or agent) fills the wizard and signs a SIWE message
flow.s2: FLAP Portal mints the token and seeds the bonding curve in one tx
flow.s3: AgentSafe is provisioned with patron + steward as co-signers
flow.s4: TaxSplitter is configured: 65% AgentSafe / 25% patron / 10% platform
flow.s5: presale fills via the FLAP bonding curve, paired with BNB
flow.s6: graduation: liquidity moves to PCS V2, progressive V3 tiers unlock at $5M / $10M / $25M / $100M MC

quickstart.guideBody: auth details, full response shape, runtime action examples, FLAP economics, TaxSplitter math, and Treasury LP claim accounting.
quickstart.intro: agents launch themselves via the FLAP Portal. humans patron the agents they want to fund. you cannot launch an agent for someone else, and an agent does not patron itself.
quickstart.metaDescription: two audiences. agents launch themselves via FLAP. humans patron.
quickstart.patronBody: a patron is the human accountable for an agent. you ratify the launch, your wallet becomes part of the TaxSplitter, and you earn 25% of every buy/sell tax the agent generates after graduation. you do not write the agent. you do not run it. you back it.
quickstart.patronCard: pick an agent. earn 25% of every trade tax. buy the bag.
quickstart.patronFooter: if volume flows, the agent eats and you earn. if it dies, nothing flows. patron with conviction.
quickstart.patronHeading: patron an agent. earn from every trade.

patronSteps.s1Body: open /agents. each card shows the agent's tier (SMOL / BASED / WAGMI / GIGACHAD), pulse, treasury, and token price.
patronSteps.s2Body: on the agent page, connect your BSC wallet. SIWE sign-in ties your patronage to the on-chain TaxSplitter.
patronSteps.s3Body: 3% buy + sell tax on graduated tokens. TaxSplitter routes 65% to the agent treasury, 25% to you, 10% to the platform. hold the bag, accrue patron yield.

quickstart.title: two audiences.

review.afterProvisionBody: you'll land on /patron/[id] in the ready_to_launch state. from there: fund the safe, pick a first-buy size, and launch the token whenever you're ready.
review.costBody: pulled from your primary Steward wallet at provision. bundle tip goes to the 48 club builder eoa for priority inclusion when the puissant bundle ships.
review.customVaultRoute: └─ 100% routes direct to your custom vault. no platform cut on-chain.
review.flapBody: your agent token (deployed via flap portal) gets a create2-mined `0x…7777` suffix. token mints + curve graduation happen atomically inside our bundle.
review.regularBlurb: regular curve. no creator tax routing, no agent treasury feed from trades.
review.remainderRoute: remainder routes through your four.meme tax allocation (founder / holders / burn / liquidity).
review.safeBody: you keep patron control over policy changes and launch timing. the agent gets constrained autonomy only through enabled adapters, caps, allowlists, and slippage rules.
review.splitVaultNote: Flap deploys a Split Vault for this routing at launch.
review.tierTotals: total {{total}} BNB • circulating mc {{circMc}} • fdv {{fdv}} includes burned supply • presaler {{presaler}}x • burn {{burn}}% • vesting {{vesting}}
review.tierVaultShare: burn / treasury / presale = 50 / 10 / 40 of the vault's share of the dev-buy
review.vanityWarning: heads up: backend skipped vanity mining. address ships as-is.

safe.adaptersFooter: customize policies after provisioning from /patron. per-tx and daily caps, allowlists, target tokens, and max slippage all live there.
safe.addressInvalid: address must be a valid 0x EVM address
safe.coOwnersHelper: add any extra EVM addresses you want on the agent Safe. raise the threshold above to require co-signs.
safe.defaultIntro: the patron steward wallet is the default safe owner. add external signers only if you want a third-party wallet available for recovery or co-signing later.
safe.externalHelper: optional linked EOAs stay 1-of-N until you raise the threshold later.
safe.pancakeBlurb: swap, supply liquidity, harvest. capped per-tx and per-day.
safe.platformNotes: platform receiver is operator-controlled; values are locked in v1. set NEXT_PUBLIC_PLATFORM_SAFE_ADDRESS and the bps env vars to override per environment.
safe.signInToLoad: sign in to load your Steward owner
safe.solanaWarning: solana sign-in is active. link an evm wallet before deploying a safe.
safe.taxRoutingBody: wave M default. tax flows on-chain through a CREATE2 TaxSplitter to the platform Safe, the patron, and the agent Safe. splits are locked per launch; expand “advanced” to audit the on-chain config.
safe.title: safe ({{threshold}}-of-{{owners}})
safe.venusBlurb: supply or borrow. health-factor floor enforced before every action.
